verses.text: N na kuna ti Duna kiyun ŋa.
Nan ti haadamarenmen (birene waxatin) bononden baane ya noxon ŋa.
Ganta ti yenmu beenu ga toŋondi; i ga da golli sirun dabari; i ga wasu me dan ga ti toŋun ŋa, nan wasu me dan na ti sabariye na.(f1)(f2)
notes: Maana: Haadamaren bireyen do a dunaadun gollun su kafumanton ŋa, fiinun naxati ga nta 1
Maana: Tuure dunkoonu... noxon ŋa, taŋi bonoyen ya ni: tonondiye; golli siri dabariye; sabariye; toŋun batiyen do a konŋe-
